summary: Keep selected-thread shortcuts out of active composers and text editors

rules.detail: Thread authority is unchanged; ordinary text input no longer dispatches selected-thread commands.

compatibility.detail: Active ordinary composers, search, mission editors and voice input own their keys before thread dispatch. Active thread inputs retain their own editor handling. List-focus thread shortcuts retain their current bindings.

downtime.detail: Restart only the terminal client to use the fix.

manual.detail: Typing words containing p/z/n/v in an ordinary conversation composer or search no longer opens a thread tab, closes a thread, starts rename or marks it read.

recovery.detail: Existing drafts and thread history are preserved.
